title: Review of Singapore's Commitment Towards Net-zero Carbon Target
what_it_is: Review of Singapore's Commitment Towards Net-zero Carbon Target

sections.label: Singapore climate plans and carbon tax
sections.summary: Singapore submitted its enhanced 2030 NDC and LEDS, launched the Green Plan 2030, set emissions goals, and put in place a broad-based carbon tax.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Last year, we submitted our enhanced 2030 Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and our Long-Term Low-Emissions Development Strategy (LEDS).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This year, we launched the Singapore Green Plan 2030, which sets out a roadmap towards sustainable development and net-zero emissions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Our goal is to peak emissions around 2030 and halve our emissions by 2050.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We have put in place a broad-based carbon tax so that companies internalise the cost of carbon, and we will be reviewing the tax trajectory and level, post-2023, to reflect the increased urgency for climate action.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We aim for our energy and chemicals sector to be amongst the best-in-class in energy and carbon efficiency globally.

sections.label: Three climate action strategies
sections.summary: Singapore will transform its industry, economy and society, invest in low-carbon technologies, and foster international collaboration on carbon markets and regional grids.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: First, we will transform our industry, economy and society to adopt more renewable energy, be more energy-efficient and reduce energy consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Second, we will invest in and draw on low-carbon technologies, such as carbon capture, utilisation and storage and low-carbon hydrogen.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Third, we will foster international collaboration in areas, such as well-functioning carbon markets and regional electricity grids.
